title: L^1 tilt-height estimate (Lemma A: L^1 form of the computation proving Simon 5.2.1)
statement: Let n >= 1, l >= 0, U open in R^(n+l), V a RectifiableVarifold n l U with generalized mean curvature H in U, z in R^(n+l), r > 0 with B_r(z) contained in U, h >= 0, and T an n-dimensional subspace with dist(x - z, T) <= h for every x in spt V cap B_r(z). Then integral_{B_{r/2}(z)} |p_x - p_T|^2 dmu <= 144 r^(-2) integral_{B_r(z)} dist(x - z, T)^2 dmu + 4 h integral_{B_r(z)} |H| dmu (Bochner integrals; |.| the Hilbert-Schmidt norm, i.e. hsNormSq).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ), V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → ∀ (z : Amb n ℓ) (r h : ℝ), 0 < r → closedBall z r ⊆ U → 0 ≤ h → ∀ T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Module.finrank ℝ T = n → (∀ x ∈ V.support ∩ closedBall z r, infDist (x - z) (T : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ h) → ∫ x in closedBall z (r / 2), hsNormSq (V.tangentProj x - T.starProjection) ∂V.weight ≤ 144 * (r ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ x in closedBall z r, infDist (x - z) (T : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ^ 2 ∂V.weight + 4 * h * ∫ x in closedBall z r, ‖H x‖ ∂V.weight
